HeartFeedback.title: HeartFeedback
HeartFeedback.description: A private listener heart and optional short feedback note for a Chaperone entry or Radio P53 transmission.

slug.description: Kebab-case track slug matching the Entry or P53 page.

pageType.description: Whether the heart originated on an Entry page or a Radio P53 transmission page.

visitorToken.description: Client-generated opaque anonymous token (12-48 chars) pairing the browser to its own heart document.

senderName.description: Optional short listener name or handle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the heart was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the heart or optional note was last updated.

/hearts/{heartId}.description: Private heart feedback records keyed by <slug>__<visitorToken>. Write-only for unauthenticated archive visitors; readable only by the verified archive owner.
